  WHY: This is documentation drift, not a code failure. A reader of the README alone would not know a green run can leave a secret uncopied.

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- changelog.d/6712-propagate-consumer-secrets-schedule.md: line 4 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The changelog fragment says `/seed-repo` "asks for manual setup only after a failed run or a `no-register` seed," but both copies of `.claude/commands/seed-repo.md` (steps 6, 8, and the Output Format checklist — the last of which the LAST RUN DIFF just updated) also list `status=skipped_empty` as a case requiring manual setup. The three seed-repo sites and the changelog are internally inconsistent within this same PR.
  WHY: When a library secret (for example `TG_BOT_SECRET`) is unset, the script logs `status=skipped_empty` and the run stays green — the consumer never receives that secret. Operators who read the changelog instead of the seed-repo checklist would not know to set it up by hand, leaving the consumer incompletely configured. The third autofix editor identified this as valid but could not fix it because the changelog path was sandbox-excluded.
